title: Spice up Your Kubernetes Environment with AWS Lambda
summary: Shows how a Lambda function triggered by SQS or SNS can forward events to an internal (ClusterIP) service in EKS through the Kubernetes API server’s service proxy, using IAM-to-RBAC mapping instead of exposing an endpoint, with code on GitHub. A clever pattern, but written for 2021-era EKS: it maps the IAM role through the `aws-auth` ConfigMap, and it routes application traffic through the cluster’s control plane.
